subject: Compact deployment agenda & MAP — Novanet: close -> implementation
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novanet.com>
Cc: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Compact deployment agenda & MAP — Novanet: close -> implementation

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for the conversation this morning — excited to get Novanet live. I put together a compact Mutual Action Plan (MAP) that embeds the post-signature implementation milestones so we can keep close timelines tight but with clear safety gates. The attached workbook (novanet_map_v1.xlsx) has:
- Week-by-week rollout cadence
- Canary windows and success criteria
- Migration cutover checklist (data, routing, DNS)
- Training schedule for ops and dev teams

High-level proposal: close this week (signature by Thu), staging canary next Mon-Wed (small traffic), production cutover two weeks later. That sequence lets us validate the integrated routing and KV-caching profile without full traffic exposure.

Asks:
1) Confirm signature target (Thu 10/15)
2) Agree to canary traffic window (Mon 10/19 02:00–06:00 PT) or propose alternate
3) Identify your internal SME who will own rollback decisions during the canary (name + mobile)

I'll loop internal engineering (PrIyom) and enablement (Grace) for technical carve-outs and training cadence.

Thanks — will update the MAP workbook once you confirm the above.

—Aditya
Aditya Rao
Enterprise Lead, Redwood Inference
aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0132

Attachment: novanet_map_v1.xlsx

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novanet.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novanet Implementation <impl-team@novanet.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 11:02:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compact deployment agenda & MAP — Novanet: close -> implementation

Aditya — thanks for the clear plan and for putting the MAP together. A few quick notes:

- Signature: Thu 10/15 works for procurement; legal still has one quick item on data retention (I will push them to sign by EOD Thu)
- Canary window: Mon 10/19 02:00–06:00 PT is acceptable. We run internal batch jobs at 03:00 PT — can we add a short freeze window from 03:00–03:30 so we can observe both systems?
- Rollback owner: I'll have our Head of Platform, Marco Liu (marco.liu@novanet.com), as decision owner for rollback during the canary. I'll introduce him once signature is in.

Couple of questions on your MAP workbook:
1) Under success criteria for the canary you list "error rate < 0.2% and p95 latency < 200ms" — can you confirm whether latency is measured from the client edge or from the origin inside Redwood?
2) Training: we need a single 90-minute runbook walkthrough for SRE + a separate 45-minute session for product owners. Can we schedule those in the week after the canary?

I'll review the attached and get back with any redlines by EOD Tue.

Best,
Elena Ortiz
Director, Cloud Operations — Novanet
elena.ortiz@novanet.com

From: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>
To: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novanet.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Oct 2026 13:40:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Compact deployment agenda & MAP — Novanet: close -> implementation

Elena — quick answers and a technical tweak to the MAP: 

1) Latency measurement: our MAP uses client-edge (Redwood API gateway) p95 for the external SLA gate. For internal diagnostics we also track origin-side metrics; I recommend the canary success criterion stay on client-edge p95 but we emit both.

2) Canary freeze: adding 03:00–03:30 PT hold window is fine. We'll block automated scaling and major config changes during that window.

3) Training: proposed slots —
   - SRE runbook walkthrough: Thu 10/22 09:00–10:30 PT (90 mins)
   - Product owners: Fri 10/23 11:00–11:45 PT (45 mins)

I've attached the shortened canary-checklist (canary-checklist.pdf) with the verification steps we will run (traffic shaping, KV cache warmup, live-route drift check, latency/error dashboards, rollback smoke tests). Also calling out rollback criteria in the checklist: sustained error rate > 0.5% for 10m OR client-edge p95 > 350ms for 5m triggers immediate rollback.

Let me know if those slots collide with your calendar and we can shift.

—PrIyom
PrIyom Das
Senior Reliability Engineer, Redwood Inference
priyom.das@redwoodinference.com

Attachment: canary-checklist.pdf

From: Elena Ortiz <elena.ortiz@novanet.com>
To: PrIyom Das <priyom.das@redwoodinference.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Novanet Implementation <impl-team@novanet.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Compact deployment agenda & MAP — Novanet: close -> implementation

Thanks PrIyom — that all sounds good. A couple follow-ups after reading the checklist: 

- Rollback triggers look sensible. For transparency, we'll also require a short post-mortem template to be automatically created if a rollback happens (we use this for our audit runs). Can you add a link or stub in the MAP so the doc is included in the workflow?
- For the SRE walkthrough, Marco is available Thu 10/22 09:00–10:30 PT. Please send calendar invites and a dial-in.

I'll confirm signature timing by EOD Thu once legal finishes the last data-retention bullet.

Best,
Elena

Elena / Marco (cc pending intro) — quick summary and next steps now that procurement sign-off is imminent:

1) Signature: aiming for Thu 10/15 — procurement confirmed. Legal redline on retention resolved (thanks Elena).
2) Canary: Mon 10/19 02:00–06:00 PT with 03:00–03:30 hold period. PrIyom will own verification, Marco is rollback decision owner for Novanet.
3) Training: SRE runbook walkthrough Thu 10/22 09:00–10:30 PT (invite sent); product owners Fri 10/23 11:00–11:45 PT.
4) Cutover: scheduled for Mon 10/26 02:00–05:00 PT pending canary success. MAP workbook and final checklist are live here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cNovanetMAP (comment access granted to Novanet impl-team).

Action items: 
- PrIyom: push canary-checklist into the MAP and add the post-mortem stub link (due: Wed 10/21)
- Elena: introduce Marco to the thread and confirm final calendar RSVPs (due: Fri 10/16)
- Grace: prepare enablement slides and quick reference playbook for the product owners (due: Fri 10/23)

I'll update HubSpot deal (DEAL-9821) with the MAP milestone and close date. Thanks everyone — looking forward to a smooth ramp.

—Aditya
